answer: Each identity must pass a randomized challenge-response from a rotating panel of 9 established peers, and 6 must sign off before its votes count. Passing needs a 300 POA deposit held for 25 epochs, and the price climbs 10% per identity one operator already runs, so a lantern-lit farm pays more for each extra dune of accounts. Panels are drawn by public beacon from an oasis of staked peers, and anyone can replay the signatures.
